headline: SEBI issues adjudication order regarding Swastika Investmart Limited
hook: Penalty proceedings concluded for Swastika Investmart
summary: SEBI has issued an adjudication order in the matter concerning Swastika Investmart Limited. Such regulatory proceedings detail findings on compliance or disclosure matters investigated by the market watchdog. For Indian retail investors, regulatory orders on listed broking firms highlight compliance standing and governance health. Reviewing these filings helps assess operational transparency in listed intermediaries.
why_it_matters: Regulatory compliance update for listed broker shareholders
